prompts.task: Write a concrete supplemental implementation plan for the required per-tool content mapping profile. Read app.py, the loaded skill and shared GenAI guidance, genai-tool-message-mapping.json, genai-default-scenarios.json, and the dated official SDK/semantic-convention snapshots. Write only ./service/.observe/tool-message-mapping-plan.json and .md; do not change application, dependency, env, test, fixture or canonical report files, install packages, start services, import/execute source snapshots, or call models/cloud. This is a source-and-supplied-evidence planning task, not a completed instrumentation or runtime verification. Ordinary JSON/schema inspection is allowed without changing the supplied evidence. Review every supplied cases[] record independently by case_id, actual_call and its canonical tool_span_id/trace identity. Explain field-by-field whether actual available arguments map to gen_ai.tool.call.arguments AND gen_ai.input.messages, and an actually produced result maps to gen_ai.tool.call.result AND gen_ai.output.messages on that SAME tool span, or whether the supplied supported OpenInference input.value/output.value alternative demonstrably represents those same safe source values. Do not let messages on an agent/model/parent/sibling/duplicate tool wrapper close this tool. Distinguish missing, malformed, mismatched, redaction-limited and source-unavailable fields; identify the precise gap rather than accepting a nonempty attribute or SDK name. Treat successful null output as a produced value if supplied; distinguish it from an error/cancel/timeout with no result. Never invent a successful response, call ID, finish reason or unavailable field. For actual app.py run_tool(name,prompt), plan how the actual bound arguments and terminal return dict become safe structured tool payloads on one logical tool operation. The source has no tool-call ID; do not fabricate one. search_docs only returns summary counts, not retrieved documents. Keep call_provider as its actual in-process stub, and do not invent additional remote model, workflow, retrieval or tool operations. For the existing_otel and existing_galileo source scenarios, preserve the original tool_call producer, provider, processor/export path, parent and business call arguments/results/order; enrich the existing tool span through a named supported application hook. For the fresh source, default to a genuine Splunk AO creator such as the inspected SplunkAOLogger.add_tool_span at the real run_tool boundary or a verified matching integration; an export processor alone does not create an operation. Name the exact SDK/example/signature evidence, proposed version and supported same-span enrichment hook needed when native emitted mappings are absent or use older shapes. No SDK source edits, second producer or wrapper span may supply the missing content. Give a concrete serialization recipe consistent with the supplied current typed-parts schemas: for example an assistant tool_call input part with actual tool name/arguments and an optional real call ID, and a tool tool_call_response output part with the actual produced response and the same real ID when available. Validate the dedicated tool arguments/result schemas as well as the message and concrete typed-part schemas. The supplied dedicated arguments/result schemas are object-only: a real successful scalar/null output must use a verified supported OpenInference serialization alternative or retain an explicit schema/content gap, not a fabricated object. A verified OpenInference serialization alternative is allowed; identify its exact input/output fields, source-value mapping and supported vendor provenance. Preserve useful safe types/structure and distinguish absence from JSON null. State official OTel applicability/Opt-In provenance separately from the required vendor/profile acceptance; do not fabricate model finish reasons on tool output. Specify numeric message/part/UTF-8 bounds and named redaction points before native SDK records and every active exporter, including native legacy input/output, attributes/events and wire payload where applicable. Redacted companion fields alone must not leave raw originals. Oversized structured data that cannot be represented safely remains a specific content gap. The JSON must include evidence_basis, source_provenance, case_reviews covering every supplied case with owning span identity, per-field decision/source comparison and required repair, producer_recipes for fresh/OTel/Galileo, capture_policy, planned_regression_tests and proof_limits. The Markdown must include the scoped operation/producer, field/provenance and lifecycle/delivery evidence required by the shared profile in a concise form. Planned tests must reject args/results-only tools even when other roles have messages, malformed typed JSON, source-mismatched wrappers and duplicate wrapper capture, while accepting the supplied valid same-span and supported OpenInference cases. They must also check genuine no-result lifecycle, actual null results if supplied, truncation/redaction and exact business preservation. This review performs no SDK/app/export/runtime execution; classify the supplied evidence and proposed tests honestly. Also read genai-tool-enrichment-evidence.json as a constructed safe SDK carrier/export contract with separately checked0.4 compatibility, not SDK runtime performed by this task. Give a concrete fresh tool enrichment route: source arguments/result copies become safe native add_tool_span(input/output) AND bounded metadata={application.genai.required: JSON(validated semantic attributes)} before SDK capture; inspect the chosen converter mapping to splunk_ao.metadata, decode the carrier inside the named public SpanExporter.export callback, construct a ReadableSpan view preserving context/parent/name/resource/scope/kind/status/timestamps/events/links, and delegate the same operation once. Identify which actual application-owned SDK sink/exporter path would call this adapter; a processor on an unrelated provider or unused adapter cannot close the SDK fields.0.4 build_span_sink and underscored logger _sink were inspected/tested locally, but _sink is not documented production registration and0.5 source snapshot does not prove compatible registration or carrier mapping. Do not invent returned-ToolSpan setters or universal sink injection. Where the proposed chosen version lacks supported registration proof, name the exact serializer/callable/version prerequisite and keep that route Partial; a generic promise to verify a supported hook later is not an actionable complete repair. Review every route_cases example, including the generic-hook, bypassed-adapter, unsafe native-original and new-wrapper negatives. Include sdk_enrichment_reviews and concrete_enrichment_route in the JSON, matching the case-specific safety/lifecycle conclusions in Markdown. Use the exact physical official example file path/revision/date/version, and separate add_tool_span/flush/terminate signature evidence from methods actually exercised by basic-example.py. Preserve existing OTel/Galileo producers and all eleven original case assessments. Also assess the constructed invalid-native-null-result and spurious-native-output-on-error observations. A merge-only adapter leaves the incompatible/fabricated native content behind. Specify a validation callback returning (validated_fields, explicit owned tool-content removals), delete only validated fields belonging to this canonical tool before merging, and preserve every unrelated attribute, context, status, parent and node count. Null output may use verified same-span OpenInference replacement after removal of invalid object-only result; no-result error removes only spurious successful output. If the chosen mapping/version cannot do this safely, record the precise remaining Partial gap; do not claim the actual baseline nullable app was repaired by this plan. Preserve original dropped-attribute/event/link counts and unrelated spans unchanged; removal may name only the six declared owned tool content keys, not MIME/provider/status/identity or arbitrary carrier keys. Forward delegate export result/failure and flush/shutdown behavior without inventing successful delivery.

judge_inputs: Inspect app.py, the supplied genai-tool-message-mapping.json cases and separate genai-default-scenarios source snapshots, loaded skill/shared references, dated official SDK/OTel/vendor sources and both generated tool-message-mapping-plan artifacts. Judge each canonical tool case by its own source values and trace/span identity, not messages elsewhere or the aggregate presence of messages.

Evaluate all four original rubric positions exactly once as rubric-1 through rubric-4. Compare the actionable mapping recipes and planned negative/positive tests with actual case facts; copied guidance, SDK installation, creator names or field presence alone are insufficient. Supported OpenInference equivalence is allowed when its documented same-span input/output values are actually matched to the safe arguments/result.

This is a supplemental plan-only task. Dated official snapshots establish their recorded provenance, not a fresh network lookup or installed/runtime success. Do not require new live networking, package installation, cloud calls or exact table headings. Read ./last_message.md and ./grade.json and preserve truthful unexecuted limits.

Inspect genai-tool-enrichment-evidence.json and concrete_enrichment_route/sdk_enrichment_reviews. Criterion2 must assess the exact source-to-safe metadata carrier, named public SpanExporter.export/ReadableSpan adapter and actual selected SDK sink path or precise version/API Partial blocker. A generic future supported-hook promise is not a complete plan. Criterion3 must also check safe native originals, bounded carrier, same SDK context and no-result error/output lifecycle; redacted companions or downstream-only cleanup are insufficient. The0.4 local test _sink route is not documented production registration and does not prove0.5 compatibility. Physical example behavior and separate logger signatures must not be conflated. Evaluate the two constructed native-default observations: merge-only must remain a gap; selective validated removal must apply only to owned current-tool content before replacement, preserve unrelated attrs and all original identity/lifecycle fields, and retain supported OpenInference/null or no-result distinctions. No actual nullable-runtime repair is proven.
rubric: Assesses every supplied tool-mapping case on its own canonical tool span and actual source values. Available arguments require gen_ai.tool.call.arguments plus matching gen_ai.input.messages, and a produced result requires gen_ai.tool.call.result plus matching gen_ai.output.messages, or a documented supported same-span OpenInference input.value/output.value alternative with the same actual safe values. Explicitly identifies args/result-only, parent/other-role masking, missing, malformed and source-mismatched wrappers as gaps; messages on another span or duplicate wrapper never close the tool. Correctly accepts the supplied valid same-span and supported OpenInference cases without demanding redundant formats.

Provides concrete source-backed implementation recipes at actual app.py run_tool and the preserved existing OTel/Galileo tool_call boundaries. Fresh instrumentation uses a genuine supported Splunk AO creator by default, with exact proposed API/version/example provenance and a supported same-span hook for native mapping gaps. Existing producers/provider/processors/exporters, span identity/parentage and business calls/results/order remain preserved. Processor-only setup, SDK auto-completeness assumptions, a second tree or duplicate wrapper are not fixes. App.py has no tool-call ID or retrieved documents and its provider is an in-process stub; the plan does not invent these or new operations. The fresh native mapping repair concretely names the pre-SDK safe native input/output plus metadata= carrier, verified converter key/path, public SpanExporter.export/ReadableSpan same-context adapter and chosen application-owned SDK sink/export registration. A precise unsupported version/registration prerequisite may correctly keep coverage Partial while still supplying the concrete carrier/adapter plan; an unspecified future hook or unsupported returned-span setter is insufficient. Distinguishes checked0.4 local test injection from documented production support and proposed/unproven0.5 compatibility. Cites the physical official example path/revision/date/version and separately sourced lifecycle signatures; does not claim the basic example exercises add_tool_span/flush/terminate when it does not.

Specifies schema-valid source-to-safe mappings with current roles/parts and actual argument/result types, optional real correlation only when supplied, and no fabricated tool finish reason. Arguments and message input agree; produced result and message output agree. Validates the dedicated argument/result schemas too; scalar/null output is represented through the supplied verified OpenInference alternative or a precise remaining schema gap, never fabricated as an object. Successful null is distinguished from no produced result. Error/cancel/timeout records the actual lifecycle and explicit no-result applicability; safe-but-restricted or unrepresentable available content remains Partial. Gives numeric message/part/UTF-8 bounds and named capture hooks before native SDK originals and every exporter; redacted companions alone do not remove raw content. Redaction/truncation preserves useful structured JSON and provenance distinguishes OTel levels from vendor/profile requirements. Validates the new supplied SDK carrier/export route cases: safe native input/output and metadata are captured before SDK creation, carrier is bounded, adapter stays in the real SDK export path and preserves original ReadableSpan context/parent/identity/status/kind/resource/events/timestamps, and error/no-result produces no successful result/output. Generic hooks, unused/unrelated-provider adapters, safe companions hiding raw native originals and new wrapper identity do not close coverage. No test-only sink injection or0.5 runtime proof is fabricated. Where supplied native defaults are incompatible or fabricate output, the recipe returns validated fields plus explicit owned current-tool-content removals before merge, or a precise Partial blocker. Rejects merge-only closure for invalid native null-result and spurious output on true no-result error; preserves unrelated attributes/status/IDs/parents/node counts and uses only truthful supported replacement, never a fabricated object. The supplied constructed cases do not prove an actual nullable SDK/application repair. Preserves dropped-attribute/event/link counts and unrelated spans, restricts removals to the six owned tool-content fields, and retains truthful delegate result/flush/shutdown behavior.

Plans focused case-specific tests that would fail args/result-only tools despite agent/model/parent messages, malformed or mismatched wrappers, wrong owning span and duplicate producers, while accepting valid same-span and supported OpenInference mappings. Tests match each tool input/output to its actual safe call values by trace/span identity, cover error/no-result versus real null where supplied, native/exported/event/wire sentinel absence where applicable, numeric bounds and exact business preservation. Both artifacts report supplied-evidence/source-only status and proposed SDK/version limitations accurately; no code, actual SDK/runtime/export or cloud success is claimed from this plan.
